note: language selector control -- renders the operator-defined language choices
theme selector control -- renders the fixed theme-selection interface
search submission control -- renders the fixed search action button while leaving the query entry masked
related navigation links -- renders the operator's fixed documentation-navigation vocabulary, excluding search and selector values
documentation navigation item -- renders the operator-defined fixed navigation label
current documentation navigation item -- renders the operator-defined fixed current-section label
documentation sidebar -- renders fixed headings, previous/next navigation, source, editing, and issue-reporting controls
site footer -- renders the operator's fixed legal, licensing, navigation, and attribution vocabulary
